hooks.name: menu_links
hooks.neoforge: none (a Java menu adds Slots over another block's IItemHandler, as Tinkers' Construct's crafting station shows the chest beside it)

rust_summary: the containers a mod menu type's linked slots show (`native_menu_links`).
doc_summary: `native_menu_links(player, menu, pos, links)` is asked on the server each tick while a mod menu type with `links` ([mods.md](mods.md#menu-types)) is open at `pos`: push the positions of block containers (chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers, droppers, mod containers) onto `links`, and the menu's linked slots show their slots, in order, as real slots: clicks, shift-clicks, drags and other mods' inventory tools move the containers' own items. Linked slots with nothing behind them hold nothing and take nothing. Bundles need "hooks": @API:menu_links@.
